Air Balloon.description: A helium balloon that grants immunity to Ground. Careful as it is very fragile and will pop upon the user receiving damage.

Antidote.description: A shot that quickly eliminates toxins, reduces fever, and relieves the pain. Heal Poison & Badly Poison.
Antidote.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Awakening.description: Sprays a water-based solution to awake a drowsy pokemon. Heal Sleep.
Awakening.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Burn Heal.description: A powder that extinguishes the fire and aids with the healing of the burnt area. Heal all Burn degrees.
Burn Heal.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Choice Band.description: Hit hard! Choose a Physical Move, increase its Power by 3. All other Moves get their Power reduced by 3.

Choice Scarf.description: Hit fast! Increase initiative by 3. Choose a Move, it gets the effect Reaction 5. All other Moves get their Power reduced by 3

Choice Specs.description: Hit fabulously! Choose a Special Move, increase its Power by 3. All other Moves get their Power reduced by 3.

Clear Amulet.description: An amulet of protection against evil. Attributes and traits of the user can't be lowered by other Pokémon.

Destiny Knot.description: The red string of fate may never break. If this Pokémon falls in love the foe will fall in love with them in return.

Eject Button.description: A tempting big red button. Do not push. After receiving damage, activate the Switcher effect for the user. Effect activates only once per Round.

Energy Root.description: A nasty-tasting root with healing properties. It can be eaten whole or turned into up to 4 batches of Remedy. (Requires Medicine Skill check)
Energy Root.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Flame Orb.description: A magical orb that casts a small fire. Warning: keep away from children & pets. User gets a 1st degree burn when they come out.

Focus Sash.description: Remain concious until the end. The first time the user would faint due to damage from a move, remain at 1 HP instead.

Full Heal.description: A superior spray formula that can heal any and all Status Ailments in a second. Heal all Status Ailments.
Full Heal.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Full Restore.description: A single-use capsule of deluxe formula. The Pokémon won't be able to restore health further until the next day. Restore Full HP & Heal Status.
Full Restore.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Heal Powder.description: A mix of the most foul-tasting herbs you can find can make this cure-all powder. Heal all Status Ailments.
Heal Powder.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Heavy-Duty Boots.description: These metal-plated boots will protect your feet even from a bear trap. The user is immune to Entry Hazards.

Hyper Potion.description: Best value pack. It can be rationed for smaller injuries on the team, or used all at once on a serious wound.
Hyper Potion.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Ice Heal.description: A heat-inducing device that recovers the normal temperature of the Pokémon and heals frost biting. Heal Frozen Solid.
Ice Heal.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Leek.description: A common leek. It is loved by Farfetch'd and gives the High Critical Effect to all their Physical and Special Moves.

Light Ball.description: A bright ball that harnesses electricity. Pikachu loves it and they get their Strength and Special Attributes increased by 1.

Loaded Dice.description: Sometimes you have to coax lady luck. Moves with Chance Dice effects get 2 Extra Chance dice on each effect

Lucky Punch.description: Boxing gloves. Chansey loves them and gets the High Critical Effect to all Physical Moves and Strength increased by 2.

Max Potion.description: A single-use capsule of formula. The Pokémon won't be able to restore health further until the next day.
Max Potion.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Max Revive.description: A bigger rock shard with enhaced effects. Found raw in deep caves. Very rare to find. Not available in stores. Restore conciousness & Full HP.
Max Revive.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Metronome.description: Follow the rhythm to attack in succession. Add 1 Extra die to the damage pool of Double, Triple, and Successive Actions.

Paralyze Heal.description: This ointment relaxes the muscles and stops the cramping. Heal Paralysis.
Paralyze Heal.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Potion.description: A pocket sized spray potion to relieve the pain and heal bruises.
Potion.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Power Herb.description: This Herb infuses a red energy. Remove the need to charge from a Charge Move. Single use

Power Increasers.description: Weighted gear, that Reduce Dexterity by 1 but grant an Increase of 2 on another Attribute/Trait of your choice.

Protective Pads.description: With this pads on you won't come into direct contact with the foe during close-range combat. Moves and Abilities that activate due to a Non-Ranged Physical Move do not trigger for the user.

Razor Claw.description: Deadly claws that trigger Evolution on certain Pokémon. All Physical and Special Moves get the High Critical Effect.

Red Card.description: Send an offending Pokémon to the bench! After receiving damage, activate the Switcher effect for the foe. Effect activates only once per Round.

Remedy.description: This powder leaves a horrid aftertaste. Pokémon will only eat it if they are injured, and even so, they'll resent you for days.
Remedy.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Revival Herb.description: It may be its magical properties or just its awful flavor, but this herb will get you back into consciousness numbing all the pain away. Very rare to find. Restore conciousness & Full HP.
Revival Herb.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Revive.description: A small energy shard that brings a fainted Human or Pokémon back into conciousness and stabilizes all their wounds. Restore conciousness & 1 HP.
Revive.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Ring Target.description: There is no escaping harm when you have a target on your back. Remove all immunities of the user.

Rocky Helmet.description: The best defense is a good offense Deal 1 damage to a foe hitting the user with a Non-Ranged Physical Move.

Safety Goggles.description: No more pesky allergies. The user is immune to the Added Effects of Moves with the words "Spore", "Powder" & "Pollen".

Sticky Barb.description: Deal 1 Damage to the user at the end of the Round. If hit with a Non-Ranged Physical Move, transfer the sticky Barb.

Super Potion.description: A regular can of concentrated formula spray. This potion can close open wounds and even heal a cracked bone.
Super Potion.scope: reviewed medicine and Recycle; lethal components excluded

Thick Club.description: A strong club made with dried bone. Cubone & Marowak love it and get their Strength Increased by 2.

Throat Spray.description: This spray relaxes vocal cords. Increase Special by 1 after using a Sound-Based Move.

Toxic Orb.description: A magical orb that oozes venom. Warning: keep away from children & pets. User gets poisoned. when they come out.

Umbrella.description: Rain or shine, you should be prepared. The user ignores the effects of Sunny, Rain and Hail weather.

Weakness Policy.description: A policy of compensation for damages. Increase user's Strength and Special by 1 after being hit with a Super-Effective Move.

White Herb.description: This Herb infuses a glowing energy. Restore any lowered Attribute/Trait. Single use.
